bristol.title: Catch-up: Finish Week 2
bristol.goal: I can show what I know about 4s and 6s and finish my Week 2 work.
bristol.desc: No new lesson today. Week 2 is not finished yet, so Bristol and Jonathan go back over the 4s (double, double) and the 6s (5s plus one more group), missing numbers like 4 × ? = 24, and multiply-or-add word problems. Tonight she finishes the Lesson 5 After-class lesson. When she gets 85 on Show What You Know, Lesson 6 opens for Tuesday.

teacher.objective: Close out Week 2 before anything new. Bristol shows she can use the 4s (double, double) and 6s (5s plus one more group), find a missing number, and choose multiply or add. No new skill is taught today.

materials: Her Lesson 3, 4 and 5 packets (she holds them up to the camera)
Optional: the Lesson 5 Class lesson (class-05.html) on screen for the fact cards and word problems
plan: Ask what she finished last week. She holds up any packet pages she did. Note what is missing.
Mix the two: you say a fact, she names the trick first, then the answer.
4 × ? = 24, 6 × ? = 42, 4 × ? = 32, 6 × ? = 36. She counts jumps or guesses, checks and fixes out loud (too small, too big).
Read each story; she says multiply or add and why (equal groups or not), then the answer.
Show the catch-up card. Tonight: the Lesson 5 After-class lesson (get 85, it opens Lesson 6) and 10 minutes of reading. Pathways Week 9 Reading by Wednesday.
key: 6 bags with 4 apples in each. How many apples?
6 red beads and 4 blue beads. How many beads?
4 dogs. Each dog has 4 legs. How many legs?
6 cats and 7 dogs at the shelter. How many animals?
teacher.decision: Tuesday: teach Lesson 6 only if Lesson 5 Show What You Know is 85 or more (Lesson 6 stays locked until then). If it is still under 85, Tuesday starts with Lesson 5 again.

bailey.title: Catch-up: Finish Week 2
bailey.goal: I can pick the fastest shortcut for any 6, 7, 8 or 9 fact and finish my Week 2 work.
bailey.desc: No new lesson today. Week 2 is not finished yet, so Bailey and Jonathan go back over the four shortcuts (×9 = ×10 minus one group, ×6 = ×5 plus one group, ×8 = double three times, ×7 = ×5 plus ×2), turn-around facts, missing factors and mixed word problems. Tonight she finishes the Lesson 5 After-class lesson. When she gets 90 on Show What You Know, Lesson 6 opens for Tuesday.
